title: Codebase Refactoring Review hotspot eval
objective: Measure whether the review ranks and verifies a low-cohesion hotspot, proposes bounded seams, and protects behavior with tests.
prompt: Use the Codebase Refactoring Review craftbook for the weekly code-health sweep. Find the least cogent areas in this fixture and write tasks/eval/refactoring-review.md. Do not change source.

setup.about: A small order service with one deliberate multi-responsibility hotspot and a thin caller/test surface.
setup.missionObjectives: Verify refactoring candidates in source, rank them, and propose behavior-preserving seams rather than a rewrite.

success.summary: tasks/eval/refactoring-review.md verifies the processOrder hotspot and proposes sequenced, test-protected seams with explicit coverage limitations.

axes.name: ranking
axes.description: Candidates are prioritized by evidence, impact, effort, risk, and blast radius.

axes.name: diagnosis
axes.description: The report explains the concrete cohesion, coupling, and testability problems.

axes.name: safe plan
axes.description: Recommendations name bounded seams, sequencing, and behavior-preserving tests.
